items.title: Doug Carn interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2023
items.q: Interviewer introduces himself as Monk Rowe and states he is pleased to have Doug Carn with him.

ctx.x: Doug was interviewed via Zoom on February 24, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Doug Carn with me this afternoon, from Florida. Congratulations on your career so far.
